correctness.rationale: The exact eigenvalue pair representation produces Fourier frequency counts (0,0,0) for each odd displacement mode and (2,2,2) for each even one. The positive full-support torus density 1-cos(x-2y) has Fourier moments 1, -1/2, -1/2 only at the required characters and therefore yields J/10. Golden-ratio irrationality, relative-interior convexity and five-dimensional Caratheodory give six real times beyond every cutoff. Numerical phase grids are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The ten-cycle is a natural composite-cycle quantum-walk benchmark with irrational golden-ratio frequencies. A specially weighted common observation-time law achieves exact expected uniformity despite the known instantaneous and ordinary-Cesaro nonuniformity. The nonnegative single-harmonic cancellation and bounded six-sample tail represent a substantive structural result, not a routine restatement of the earlier average-mixing formalism.
